item.title: EplayerX 1.2.27
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 重新设计人物详情页，加入作品海报墙、柔和的人物背景和更清晰的简介布局。 - 优化服务器合集的预览、卡片样式和首页展示，让社区与首页的合集外观保持一致。 - 改善合集样式选择，仅在有可用封面时提供封面展示样式。 - 修复部分字幕轨道名称缺失或重复显示的问题，让字幕选择更容易辨认。 - 改善 ASS 字幕渲染的稳定性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Redesigned person detail pages with a wall of work posters, a soft portrait backdrop, and a clearer biography layout. - Improved server collection previews, card styles, and Home presentation for a consistent appearance across Community and Home. - Refined collection style selection so cover-based styles appear only when cover artwork is available. - Fixed missing or duplicated names for some subtitle tracks, making subtitles easier to identify. - Improved the stability of ASS subtitle rendering.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
